codex.root_final_source: From output.app_server_events select entries whose runtime_generation equals output.runtime_generation, message.method is rawResponseItem/completed, message.params.threadId equals output.thread_id, message.params.turnId equals output.turn_id, item.type is message, item.role is assistant, and item.phase is final_answer. Require exactly one such item; join its content parts of type output_text in order.
root_final_exclusions: different turnId including earlier root turns
codex.owner_business_input_source: From each formal child's own commandExecution items whose recorded command text references both the producer CLI (contact_state.py) and any supported stage5 action word (stage5-list-inputs, stage5-partition-choices, stage5-plan or stage5-rebuild-overview), read the one-professor business object the child actually consumed: email_pack plus that owner's own choices rows. Strict flag parsing is not required: the real Codex child calls the CLI through python3 -c / wrapper compound expressions with the action words inside quoted strings, and the packet rides embedded as JSON or a Python literal in that same command text; both supported forms are decoded from the command text. Require exactly one attributable object per formal child.
owner_business_input_exclusions: child task input delivered as item.type agent_message with an input_text NEW_TASK shell plus encrypted_content, which carries no plaintext business object
items of other threads or other runtime generations
business objects in command texts that do not invoke a supported stage5 CLI; echo/log and diagnostic examples are not consumption evidence
codex.owner_business_input_fallback: A plaintext child user message (rawResponseItem/completed, item.type message, item.role user) remains the delivery fallback for hosts that hand the business object to the child itself; it is used only when the child has no stage5 command surface carrying a business object, and it keeps the frozen BLOCKED_OBSERVABILITY reason code completed_user_payload_unobservable when it is absent or not unique.
codex.owner_input_isolation: Each formal child's consumed object may carry only that owner's own bundle: no sibling sentinel, professor_dir, email_pack, email_id, choice row or path, and no choices_scope field or complete multi-professor choices/scope. A consumed object carrying any sibling marker or a choices_scope field is a product failure.
codex.canonical_preservation: The consumed choices must equal the manifest per-owner expected rows after parsing (exact value equality; serialization form, key order and whitespace are never a failure). professor_dir and email_id strings are preserved byte for byte, including characters such as 試験; translation, transcription or reconstruction is a product failure.
codex.partition_evidence: The root must execute the supported stage5-partition-choices entry exactly once successfully on the root thread, with per-owner bundles matching the manifest partition record; a partition executed by a child, more than one successful root partition, or no successful root partition is a product failure. The successful root partition must also complete before any owner business call starts: an owner business command on a child thread that starts before the partition completed is a product failure (owner_business_precedes_partition). Discovery must not carry --emit-choices-scope and a plan must not carry --choices-scope.
codex.orchestration_surface: Root orchestration (discovery, partition, rebuild) is recognized on two surfaces: a call whose command parses strictly under the frozen flag grammar keeps every flag fact, and a compound preparation command (python3 -c / wrapper expression whose action words are quoted string fragments) is attributed by the loose business-surface text shape plus its single stage5 action word. Output facts always come from the commandExecution aggregatedOutput on both surfaces. Compound commands provide no flags, so the --emit-choices-scope, --choices-scope and --program-root checks only cover strictly parsed calls. A compound text carrying two or more action words cannot be attributed to one orchestration step and is BLOCKED_OBSERVABILITY/root_orchestration_ambiguous; on a child thread only a strictly parsed partition, or a compound text whose single action word is stage5-partition-choices, proves partition_executed_by_owner, and every other compound child command is judged by the packet oracle alone.
codex.wait_consume_evidence: The root's result consumption per formal child is proven only by the root thread's rawResponseItem/completed agent_message FINAL_ANSWER receipt: the item author is the child's agent path (for example /root/stage5_x), the Payload JSON line after the 'Payload:' marker names that owner's professor_dir, and its professor_dir/status/reason_code outcome equals the outcome the child itself returned on its own thread; the receipt's runtime_seq is the consumption point and the aggregate must not run before every owner's receipt. The official Codex V2 wait implementation (openai/codex multi_agents_v2/wait.rs) always returns empty receiver_thread_ids/agents_states and a WaitAgentResult.message that is only the 'Wait completed.' status text, so collabAgentToolCall wait pairing fields are never consumption evidence. A missing receipt stays BLOCKED_OBSERVABILITY with reason code root_result_consumption_unobservable and is never passed on the strength of wait or completion events; a receipt whose seq precedes the child's own turn/completed is INVALID_EVIDENCE/root_receipt_precedes_child_completion, receipts carrying more than one distinct outcome for one owner are INVALID_EVIDENCE/root_result_receipt_ambiguous, and a receipt outcome that differs from the child's returned outcome is FAIL_PRODUCT/root_receipt_payload_changed.
codex.terminal_precedence: A proven FAIL_PRODUCT is never downgraded to a blocked or invalid terminal by another formal child's missing or ambiguous evidence.
codex.formal_ownership: Use the shared adapter @16 formal topology only. Identity diagnostics cannot create, rewrite, upgrade or downgrade ownership.
